🎬 The Good Doctor (2017–2024)

The Good Doctor follows Dr. Shaun Murphy, a brilliant young surgeon with autism and savant syndrome who joins the surgical team at San Jose St. Bonaventure Hospital in California. Despite his extraordinary medical knowledge and remarkable ability to recognize complex patterns, Shaun faces challenges involving communication, social interactions, and gaining the trust of colleagues who question whether he can succeed in a demanding hospital environment. With the support of his mentor, Dr. Aaron Glassman, Shaun works tirelessly to prove that his unique perspective can help save lives and make him an exceptional doctor. From complicated surgeries and rare medical conditions to emotional patient stories, difficult ethical decisions, and intense hospital emergencies, Shaun and his fellow physicians encounter challenges that test their skills and compassion. As he develops friendships, navigates romantic relationships, and confronts painful memories from his childhood, Shaun gradually discovers new ways to connect with the people around him. Meanwhile, his colleagues face their own professional rivalries, personal struggles, and life-changing decisions while working together to provide the best possible care. Through unexpected setbacks, medical breakthroughs, and powerful emotional moments, Shaun’s journey demonstrates the importance of determination, understanding, and believing in someone’s potential. Combining gripping medical drama, heartfelt storytelling, and memorable characters, the series explores compassion, acceptance, resilience, friendship, love, and the challenges of finding your place in the world.

🎭 Genre: Medical Drama • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 8.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: 41–44 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Developer: David Shore

source_details.synopsis: The Good Doctor is an American medical drama television series, a remake of the 2013 South Korean series of the same name, which aired on ABC from September 25, 2017, to May 21, 2024, lasting seven seasons and 126 episodes. The series stars Freddie Highmore as Shaun Murphy, a young surgical resident with autism and savant syndrome at the fictional San Jose St. Bonaventure Hospital. Christina Chang, Richard Schiff, Will Yun Lee, Fiona Gubelmann, Paige Spara, Noah Galvin and Bria Samoné Henderson also star in the show.
